clue.text: In old college, use of computers one term, as parties are organised

definitions.note: an adverbial phrase: in the manner of political parties

indicators.note: the clue's opening word says the following pieces sit inside the old college

parts.note: a poly was a polytechnic, a type of British college before 1992
IT is information technology
I is the Roman numeral one
to call something is to term it

explanation.surface: A student recalls computer use at an old college during a term of party politics.
explanation.walkthrough: A poly (polytechnic) was a British higher-education college, replaced by universities in 1992.
explanation.definitionFit: Parties are organised along lines of government and policy, the adverb describing that manner.

clue.text: Officer left in charge, introduced to author to artist

indicators.note: the left and in-charge letters are introduced into the author's name

parts.note: Edgar Allan Poe, the American writer
John Constable, the English landscape painter

explanation.surface: An officer left in charge introduces a writer to a painter.
explanation.walkthrough: John Constable was an English landscape painter; Poe the American author.
explanation.definitionFit: A British police rank holder is the lowest-ranked kind of officer on the force.

clue.text: Sub, in practice, rewriting most of column

indicators.note: rewriting reorders the remaining letters of the shortened word
most of drops the final letter of the word column

parts.note: taken as written, losing its last letter

explanation.surface: A newspaper sub-editor rewrites most of a column during practice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sub' suggests a sub-editor, apt beside 'column', but it means a stand-in doctor in a medical practice.
explanation.definitionFit: A doctor who substitutes temporarily in a medical practice is the classic stand-in.

clue.text: Bald spot in style? Absolutely!

parts.note: ton means fashion or style, as in high society
sure! is an exclamation of agreement like absolutely

explanation.surface: Someone asks if a bald spot is stylish and gets an emphatic yes.
explanation.walkthrough: TON is an old word for fashionable style.
explanation.definitionFit: A monk's shaved crown is a deliberate bald patch on the head.

clue.text: What's right and proper in cleric or rector?

indicators.note: in shows the letters sit within the words cleric or rector

explanation.surface: A question of etiquette: what is the proper way to address a clergyman?
explanation.definitionFit: Something right and proper is accurate and fitting, a synonym of the adjective.

clue.text: Formation of troops moving forward on part of flight

parts.note: a lock is one of a flight of locks on a canal
a step is one of a flight of stairs

explanation.surface: Soldiers advance in formation along part of a flight of stairs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flight' is read twice: a flight of canal locks and a flight of stairs.
explanation.definitionFit: Marching in close file with each soldier's feet moving in unison is the military meaning.

clue.text: Play without determination?

definitions.meaning: a comedy by George Bernard Shaw
a phrase meaning nobody can determine or predict the outcome

explanation.definitionFit: Shaw wrote a comedy with this title, and the phrase means an outcome cannot be predicted.

clue.text: A charlatan welcoming king in religious retreat

indicators.note: welcoming means the fraud takes the king into the middle

parts.note: a sham is a fraud or impostor
R is short for rex, Latin for king

explanation.surface: A fraudulent guru takes in a king at a religious retreat.
explanation.definitionFit: A Hindu hermitage or community for spiritual retreat is a kind of religious retreat.

clue.text: Feature a small computer, absorbing energy and time

indicators.note: absorbing means the computer takes energy inside it

parts.note: PC is a personal computer
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A small computer's feature is that it uses energy and time.
explanation.definitionFit: An aspect is a facet or characteristic, so a synonym of feature as a noun.

clue.text: I left in second symbol on screen, a vital element in 1 across 4, 1 down, or 25, in short

definitions.text: a vital element in 1 across 4, 1 down, or 25, in short

indicators.note: in places the I and left letters inside the second plus screen symbol

parts.note: an icon is a small symbol on a computer screen

explanation.surface: Computer talk about icons and an element vital to PCs.
explanation.walkthrough: The cross-references are 1 across with 4 (a correct-thinking phrase), 1 down and 25, each abbreviated to PC; the element is vital to a personal computer's chips.
explanation.definitionFit: The semiconductor element from which computer chips are made is essential to every personal computer.

clue.text: Compensates PC user, distraught about nothing

indicators.note: about puts the scrambled letters around the zero
a distraught user is in a state, so the letters are jumbled

parts.note: O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A computer user, upset over losing everything, gets compensation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'distraught' jumbles PCUSER into RECUPS; 'about' puts it around O.
explanation.definitionFit: To recoup losses is to make them good, a synonym for compensates or recovers.

clue.text: Check accuracy of general opinion about Communist

indicators.note: about puts the reputation around the Communist abbreviation

parts.note: repute is the general opinion held of someone
COM is an abbreviation for Communist

explanation.surface: Someone verifies a public view about a Communist figure.
explanation.definitionFit: To calculate again is a way to verify a figure, the verb sense of checking.

clue.text: Jobs in computing, among greatest ever

indicators.note: among shows the name sits inside the words greatest ever

explanation.surface: A tribute calling a computing pioneer one of the greatest ever.
explanation.definitionFit: Apple's co-founder Steve Jobs is the computing figure, so his first name fits.

clue.text: 15 and 19 returned email from Nigeria?

definitions.note: plural: the two entries, a rain garment and a Highlander, both share a nickname

indicators.note: returned reads the fraud word from right to left

parts.note: the notorious Nigerian email is a fraud or scam

explanation.surface: A suspicious email from Nigeria is sent back.
explanation.walkthrough: A mac is a raincoat (15) and Mac is slang for a Scot (19); the reversed fraud gives the plural.
explanation.definitionFit: Mac is short for mackintosh, a waterproof coat, and also a nickname for a Scotsman.

clue.text: End of dispute in colony

definitions.meaning: an agreement that resolves a disagreement
a community of settlers in a new territory

explanation.definitionFit: A resolution of a quarrel and a newly founded colonial community both bear this name.

clue.text: Croatian altered protective garment

indicators.note: altered says the word Croatian is rearranged

explanation.surface: A Croatian has altered a protective garment.
explanation.definitionFit: A coat worn against wet weather is a protective item of clothing.

clue.text: A US line changed, put in and converted to yearly rate

indicators.note: put in says the jumbled letters go inside the word and
changed rearranges the letters of A US line

explanation.surface: An American railway line is reorganised and its figures annualised.
explanation.walkthrough: 'line' looks like a railway, but it is fodder for 'changed'; the word 'and' is the container that the jumbled letters are 'put in'.
explanation.definitionFit: Figures expressed per year rather than per month are said to be on an annual basis.

clue.text: Simple program computer company sent, finally

parts.note: Apple, the computer firm Steve Jobs co-founded

indicators.note: finally takes the last letter of the word sent

explanation.surface: A computer company finally sends out a simple program.
explanation.definitionFit: A small application run inside another program is a simple piece of software.

clue.text: Slight cut in hormone we all need

indicators.note: cut docks the last letter of the slight

parts.note: an insult is a slight
taken as written

explanation.surface: A minor cut contains a hormone everybody needs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Slight cut' looks like a small wound, but the slight is an INSULT with its last letter cut.
explanation.definitionFit: The pancreatic hormone regulating blood sugar is one every body requires.

clue.text: Releases minute part in journalist's account?

indicators.note: in sets the minute and part letters inside the expenses

parts.note: exes are expenses, as claimed by a journalist

explanation.surface: A journalist's expense claim releases a minute portion.
explanation.walkthrough: EXES is informal for expenses, famously claimed by reporters.
explanation.definitionFit: To exempt someone is to free them from an obligation, so releases as a verb.

clue.text: Old payment business set in stone

indicators.note: set in places the company letters inside the stone abbreviation

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for stone, the British weight of 14 pounds
CO is short for company

explanation.surface: A business sets an old payment in stone.
explanation.walkthrough: ST is stone, a British weight of 14 pounds; scot was an old tax, as in scot-free.
explanation.definitionFit: An old tax or levy survives in the phrase scot-free, meaning without paying.

clue.text: In excessively sentimental way set up online messages

parts.note: twee means cloyingly cute or sentimental

indicators.note: set up, in a down clue, lifts the street letters so they read upwards

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for street, a way

explanation.surface: Gushing posts set up online.
explanation.definitionFit: Short posts on the platform formerly called Twitter are messages sent online.

clue.text: Elected foreign leader, repeatedly

definitions.meaning: chosen by vote, as in voted into office
the Russian leader who has held office again and again

explanation.definitionFit: Voters install a candidate in office, and Russia's president has been returned repeatedly.

clue.text: Realises error in various points

parts.note: a run of compass points: south, east, east, south
more compass points: south, east, north, south, east

explanation.surface: Someone recognises a mistake in a number of points.
explanation.walkthrough: Every letter is a compass point (S, E or N); the run splits into two words.
explanation.definitionFit: Coming round to reason after being wrong is the idiom for realising a mistake.

clue.text: Time in 9 that's provided for rest of travellers

definitions.text: that's provided for rest of travellers

indicators.note: in places the time period inside the chemical symbol

parts.note: the element at 9 across has the chemical symbol Si
an era is a period of time

explanation.surface: A rest stop for travellers is supplied at a certain time.
explanation.walkthrough: The 9 stands for the 9-across element through its chemical symbol.
explanation.definitionFit: A caravanserai, an inn where travellers in the East rested, is a place provided for rest.

clue.text: Involve little brother, cutting back tree

indicators.note: cutting says the brother splits the reversed tree
back turns the tree word around

parts.note: the lime is a tree
bro is short for brother

explanation.surface: A small boy gets involved cutting back a tree.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns LIME into EMIL, which BRO cuts.
explanation.definitionFit: To embroil someone is to drag them into a conflict, a stronger synonym of involve.

clue.text: Line drawn between circles as measure of concentration

definitions.meaning: describes the % sign, a slash between two small circles
a proportion out of a hundred used to measure strength

explanation.definitionFit: The % symbol looks like a slash between two rings, and concentrations are given per hundred.

clue.text: Become completely satisfied when stallion fee is adjusted

indicators.note: adjusted means the letters of stallion fee are reorganised

explanation.surface: A horse breeder is satisfied once the stud fee is adjusted.
explanation.definitionFit: To eat as much as one wants is an idiom for being fully sated.
